uncertainties: OC fees UNCONFIRMED for every one of the ten properties. No lot-specific levy amount was established; generic $333/month (roughly $4,000/year) is not a property quote. Special levies extra.

All lending, guarantee, Help to Buy contribution, property, valuation, grant and duty eligibility are conditional; no applications or enquiries were made.

Australian-citizen couple, $48,000 savings, $165,000 combined salary excluding super and $2,700 rent are scenario inputs. Equal $82,500 taxable salaries, no debts/HELP, $3,600 living, $800 owner costs and $1,000 monthly headroom are assumptions.

Help to Buy FY2026 ATO notices govern indexed income screening; exact $165,000 joint taxable income is inside the retained inclusive threshold, not proof of eligibility. No numeric asset ceiling established. Cannot stack with guarantee.

NAB/Bank Australia ordinary high-LVR rates are not confirmed scheme pricing. Bendigo scheme comparison rate and fee amounts unknown. Retained announced future rate increases are not substituted for dated rates.
Sales are agency-published completed-sale examples, not registry certification, available listings, representative medians, valuations or future stock. All ten supersede earlier unverified leads.

9/1110 Glen Huntly Road advertised a lease expiring February 2027; no vacant-possession promise. Its raw listing has an unrelated weekly/annual rental arithmetic inconsistency, not repeated in the guide.

Workbook read in full across Calculator, Compare and Sources; cached values inspected without editing or recalculating it. Historical LMI rows stay at 95% LVR; Help to Buy is not automatically modelled. Original verification claims are retained history, not a new engine verification.
